text: WP Suspension is one of the Bajaj Mobility group brands: the group's site says Bajaj Mobility AG is the holding company of KTM AG and that its premium brand range includes the WP components brand. Bajaj Mobility AG (formerly PIERER Mobility AG) is owned to around 74.9% by Bajaj Auto International Holdings AG, an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Bajaj Auto Ltd, India, with a 25.1% free float.
short: WP is a KTM-group brand; the group is 74.9% owned by Bajaj Auto of India.

source.name: Bajaj Mobility AG – homepage
source.quote: The premium brand range also includes the high-performance components of the WP brand.
